observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Various indoor and outdoor locations including a courtyard, community hall, and room with a green screen backdrop, with spectators watching
observation.dancers: Mixed group of adult men and women dancing in couples, plus occasional solo dancers and children
observation.formation_and_space: Couples dancing in close proximity, moving around open floor spaces while spectators stand or sit around the perimeter
observation.posture: Upright torso with slightly bent knees and relaxed weight distribution
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping side-to-side and shifting weight on the beat; detailed footwork is obscured by camera angles and low resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held in close partner embrace or open handholds, occasionally gesturing outward
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle hip movement and torso shifting in time with the music
observation.partnering: Close partner contact with embraces, holds, and lead-and-follow dynamics
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Stands upright with occasional dips, turns, and pivots
observation.costume_and_props: Casual everyday clothing, dresses, and formal wear
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placements, precise weight transfers, and lower body details are partially obscured by video compression and camera cuts.

signature_moments.what: Couples side-by-side shifting weight with knees bent and arms held up
Close embrace partner turn with rhythmic stepping
